scenarios.name: red-noncombat-damage-below-power-raised-to-four
scenarios.why: The controlled red source would deal three noncombat damage to an opponent, less than Ojer Axonil's four power, so it deals four instead.

scenarios.name: exact-power-combat-damage-is-unchanged
scenarios.why: Ojer's replacement is limited to noncombat damage; its own four combat damage is unchanged, at the exact value of its power.
